summary: Frontend testing of 4 Sala Sitor improvements (iteration 249). All 4 flows verified working end-to-end against the live preview (https://edit-33.preview.emergentagent.com). Auth flow required admin-gate PIN 198505 + admin login (admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026!). Board API returns 5 free operators as documented. History API returns single month (2026-09, -73%, 9 optimized) — savings-history section correctly hidden (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: OperatorStatusBoard.jsx is clean and well-structured (127 lines).
CreditSavingsBadge.jsx correctly gates savings-history behind hist.length>1 — matches spec.
Tour suppression via document.querySelector('[data-tour-suppress]') polling on both LabTour and SitorTour is correctly wired to VoiceDelegation modal (data-tour-suppress='true').
test_credentials: Admin gate PIN 198505; Admin admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (matches memory/test_credentials.md convention)
seed_data_creation: None — used the 5 pre-seeded free operators (Michele/Forno, Ahmed/Forni, Sara/Impastatore, Antonio/Impastatore, Luca/Pulizie) provided by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow: raw POST /api/admin-gate/verify {pin:'198505'} then /api/auth/login, THEN set localStorage.mikilab_admin_unlocked='1' and reload. DO NOT set mikilab_admin_unlocked before the gate cookie is issued, otherwise the axios 401 interceptor triggers infinite reload. Sala Sitor renders on the default landing page — just scrollIntoView on [data-testid=sala-sitor].

test_results_detail.T1_department_filter: PASS — 5 filter chips rendered (Tutti + Forni/Forno/Impastatore/Pulizie). Click Impastatore → 2 rows (Sara, Antonio) and header totals updated to '2 liberi'. 'Tutti' restored 5 rows.
test_results_detail.T2_assign_one_tap: PASS — Click board-assign-0 (Michele) triggered POST /api/worker/assign-next → 200 {assigned:false, message:'Nessun compito pendente da assegnare'}. Info toast displayed. No task existed to assign (expected in clean state).
test_results_detail.T3_savings_history_expandable: PASS — GET /api/ai/savings/history?months=6 → 200 with 1 entry (2026-09, -73%, 9 optimized). credit-savings-badge visible; savings-history section correctly NOT rendered because hist.length===1 (spec compliant). Badge shows -73%, 7 su modello economico, 2 riuso dalla cache.
test_results_detail.T4_tour_vs_modal: PASS — Before opening modal: sitor-tour count=1 (visible bottom-right). After clicking sitor-delegate-btn: voice-delegation modal opens with data-tour-suppress='true'; sitor-tour count drops to 0 (component unmounts because modalOpen state polling detects [data-tour-suppress]). lab-tour also not visible.

no_regressions_check: Confirmed data-testid=sitor-delegate-btn opens Delega Vocale modal correctly (as in iter 247/248). Credit badge renders base metrics. Board polling every 15s still active.
